verses.verse:
स्वरद्वयम् प्रकल्प्याथ त्रयम् वा तु चतुष्टयम्।
स्वकल्पित क्रमेणैव समुदायम् प्रकल्पयेत्।११०।
verses.text: Having set up two notes, or three, or four, one should form a samudāya (group of notes) in an order of one's own devising.

commentary.text: That is, taking two notes, or more, three or four notes, and carrying through the elements above in them, the sādhaka (practitioner) should compose samudāyas (groups of notes) of various orders on the basis of his own imagination.
